note: Snapshot of the seeded rules (db/migrations). test_db checks it matches the database.

fib_pivot.confirmation.description: When price reaches the Confirmation level in the trade direction, the signal is marked confirmed and an update is sent.
fib_pivot.confirmation.name: Confirmation

fib_pivot.confluence.description: When a 3/8 signal and a Fibonacci Pivot signal agree in direction on the same pair within confluence_bars, both show a confluence marker. Does not change either signal.
fib_pivot.confluence.name: Confluence marker

fib_pivot.entry.description: Long when a completed 15-minute bar closes above the upper Break, short on a close below the lower Break. Entry is that bar close.
fib_pivot.entry.name: Entry

fib_pivot.expiry.description: Open signals expire at the 17:00 New York roll.
fib_pivot.expiry.name: Expiry

fib_pivot.levels.description: Range in units = prior day high minus low. Take the closest Fibonacci number (ties go to the larger), clamped to min_fib and max_fib, and the next three as offsets. Pivot = prior day close. Break, Confirmation, Take Profit, Reset at Pivot plus and minus each offset.
fib_pivot.levels.name: Level calculation

fib_pivot.one_per_side.description: At most max_per_side_per_day long and short signals per pair per day.
fib_pivot.one_per_side.name: One signal per side per day

fib_pivot.reset.description: If price reaches Reset, the signal is marked extended and an update is sent.
fib_pivot.reset.name: Reset reached

fib_pivot.stop.description: Stop at the Pivot (prior close), or at the opposite Break.
fib_pivot.stop.name: Stop

fib_pivot.unit.description: Unit used to convert the range to a Fibonacci number. Forex uses pips.
fib_pivot.unit.name: Unit
fib_pivot.unit.source: Fibonacci Pivot Point notes (example in dollars and cents); spec 07 interpretation

fib_pivot.window.description: Triggers are checked during the 3/8 trading window so the two systems share a schedule.
fib_pivot.window.name: Trading window

stocks.alert_new_confirmed.description: One evening digest lists stocks that reached trend confirmed today and were not confirmed in the prior cooldown_sessions, up to max_in_digest.
stocks.alert_new_confirmed.name: Newly confirmed digest

stocks.alert_target_reached.description: Alert when a holding closes at or above its sales target.
stocks.alert_target_reached.name: Sales target reached

stocks.alert_time_elapsed.description: Alert when a holding reaches horizon_sessions without hitting its target.
stocks.alert_time_elapsed.name: Time elapsed

stocks.five_line.description: For N in periods: ACC_N = (C0 minus CN) / CN; APR_N = ACC_N / N times trader_year.
stocks.five_line.name: Five line chart
stocks.five_line.source: Financial Wealth Building 1, five line chart

stocks.history_required.description: A stock needs at least min_sessions of history. 52-week high and low use the highest high and lowest low over lookback_sessions.
stocks.history_required.name: History required

stocks.liquidity.description: Exclude stocks below min_price or with average volume over avg_volume_sessions below min_avg_volume. Set both to 0 to switch off.
stocks.liquidity.name: Liquidity

stocks.rule1_near_high.description: Last close at least the 52-week high times ratio.
stocks.rule1_near_high.name: Close near the 52-week high

stocks.rule2_double.description: 52-week high at least the 52-week low times multiple.
stocks.rule2_double.name: High at least twice the low

stocks.rule3_apr.description: APR = (52-week high minus 52-week low) / 52-week low, at least min_apr.
stocks.rule3_apr.name: Annual percentage rate

stocks.sales_target.description: Sales target = purchase price times (1 + expected profit). Daily target = earnings / horizon_sessions; weekly = daily times 5. Defaults for new holdings.
stocks.sales_target.name: Sales target

stocks.trend_confirmed.description: The 50-day confirms the trend: ACC_50 greater than min_acc while the 20-day condition holds.
stocks.trend_confirmed.name: Trend confirmed

stocks.trend_consistent.description: ACC_5 and ACC_10 both greater than min_acc. Shown as a flag; required for an alert only when required_for_alert is on.
stocks.trend_consistent.name: Consistent movement
stocks.trend_consistent.source: Financial Wealth Building, Steps 3 to 5; spec 08 interpretation

stocks.trend_established.description: The 20-day establishes a trend: ACC_20 greater than min_acc.
stocks.trend_established.name: Trend established

stocks.universe.description: Active common stocks on NYSE, Nasdaq, and NYSE American. OTC excluded.
stocks.universe.name: Universe
stocks.universe.source: Financial Wealth Building, comb through the entire NYSE and the Nasdaq

three_eight.candlestick.description: A listed pattern completes on the signal bar or the bar before it, in the signal direction. Shaved head or bottom: upper (or lower) shadow at most shaved_max_shadow_pct of the bar range. Doji and spinning top count in the trigger direction.
three_eight.candlestick.name: Candlestick formation

three_eight.cooldown.description: No new 3/8 signal on the same pair and direction within bars of the previous one, even at a different level.
three_eight.cooldown.name: Cooldown

three_eight.countertrend.description: A countertrend candidate needs a move of at least min_move_pips in the trend direction since the last opposite swing, not made within fast_move_bars bars (a fast_move_pips move that fast blocks it). After a consolidation of new_trend_consolidation_hours that resolves the other way, the move is a new trend.
three_eight.countertrend.name: Countertrend exception

three_eight.daily_goal.description: Daily goal of goal_min_pips to goal_max_pips from closed signal outcomes. When suppress_after_goal is on, new 3/8 alerts on a pair stop once the goal is reached that day.
three_eight.daily_goal.name: Daily target
three_eight.daily_goal.source: 3/8 Formula, Daily target 60 to 75 pips; suppression is spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.econ.description: Within window_minutes after a logged high-impact event for either currency: countertrend only off a single 15-minute bar of at least large_bar_pips; a large move followed by a reversing candle is always allowed regardless of stop distance; Fibonacci levels may not be targets.
three_eight.econ.name: Econ reports
three_eight.econ.source: 3/8 Formula, Econ reports; large bar size is spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.entry.description: Entry is the close of the signal bar (reference mid price). Broker adjustment is applied later.
three_eight.entry.name: Entry

three_eight.expiry.description: An open signal expires at the end of the trading window or after max_bars bars, whichever comes first.
three_eight.expiry.name: Signal expiry

three_eight.fibonacci.description: Price trades within tolerance_pips of a retracement of the last leg. ratio_set fib uses 0.382, 0.5, 0.618; thirds uses 1/3, 1/2, 2/3.
three_eight.fibonacci.name: Fibonacci

three_eight.flag_pennant_triangle.description: Pole: a move of at least pole_min_pips within pole_max_bars. Consolidation: cons_min_bars to cons_max_bars bars fitting converging or parallel lines. Fires on a close beyond the consolidation in the pattern direction. Projected target: pole length from the breakout.
three_eight.flag_pennant_triangle.name: Flags, pennants, triangles
three_eight.flag_pennant_triangle.source: 3/8 Formula, Flags, pennants, triangles; spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.hl_failure.description: Price tests the high of the most recent up leg (for shorts) or the low of the most recent down leg (for longs) within test_tolerance_pips and the bar closes without exceeding it.
three_eight.hl_failure.name: New high/low failure

three_eight.hook_reversal.description: After a leg of at least min_leg_pips, two consecutive bars form a reversal hook: the second bar opens beyond and closes back inside the first bar range.
three_eight.hook_reversal.name: Hook reversal / blended hook

three_eight.min_indicators.description: The count of fired counting indicators in the candidate direction must be at least minimum. The trigger indicator counts.
three_eight.min_indicators.name: Minimum indicators

three_eight.pdh.description: Price trades within tolerance_pips of the previous New York day high. Supports shorts at a rejection and longs on a confirmed break and retest.
three_eight.pdh.name: Previous day's high

three_eight.pdl.description: Price trades within tolerance_pips of the previous New York day low. Mirror of the previous day high rule.
three_eight.pdl.name: Previous day's low

three_eight.pivot_touch.description: Price trades within the tolerance of a pivot level: daily 10 pips, weekly 15, monthly 15. Daily and weekly (or monthly) levels within double_pivot_pips of each other are marked double pivot.
three_eight.pivot_touch.name: Pivots

three_eight.range_detect.description: Ranging when, over the last lookback_bars, price retested the same high or low at least min_retests times within retest_tolerance_pips, and the range is at least min_width_pips wide.
three_eight.range_detect.name: Range detection
three_eight.range_detect.source: 3/8 Formula, Transitioning market; thresholds are spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.range_mode.description: In range mode: candidates inside the range, long near the low, short near the high; Fibonacci and countertrend allowed; minimum count is range_minimum; targets cap at the opposite side of the range.
three_eight.range_mode.name: Range mode
three_eight.range_mode.source: 3/8 Formula, Show more flexibility; settings are spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.reward_risk.description: Target distance divided by stop distance must be at least min_ratio.
three_eight.reward_risk.name: Target greater than risk

three_eight.stop.description: At a pivot trigger: stop beyond the nearest pivot on the far side of entry, at pivot_stop_min_pips to pivot_stop_max_pips. Otherwise buffer_pips beyond the previous swing, using the smallest distance within fallback_min_pips to fallback_max_pips that clears it.
three_eight.stop.name: Stop

three_eight.stop_feasible.description: The planner must find a valid stop. If not, no trade.
three_eight.stop_feasible.name: Stop placement possible

three_eight.swing.description: Swing highs and lows come from a ZigZag that reverses after threshold_pips. Trend is up when the last two swing highs and lows are both higher, down when both lower, otherwise none.
three_eight.swing.name: Swings and trend state
three_eight.swing.source: 3/8 Formula, Trade with the trend; spec 06 context

three_eight.target.description: Furthest pivot in the trade direction within daily_target_max_pips, capped at the previous day high (longs) or low (shorts) when that lies between. Countertrend: nearest Fibonacci level, then nearest pivot, capped at countertrend_target_max_pips. Pattern targets shown as an alternative. When reject_below_min is on, a target closer than daily_target_min_pips means no trade; when off, the minimum is shown only.
three_eight.target.name: Target
three_eight.target.source: 3/8 Formula, Target is always furthest pivot unless resistance; spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.thrust_candle.description: A bar whose body is at least min_body_pips. Shown as supporting evidence; admins can switch on counting toward the minimum.
three_eight.thrust_candle.name: Thrust candle

three_eight.trading_window.description: Bar close time must fall inside the active window. Primary 00:00 to 10:30, alternative 05:00 to 14:00, in the configured time zone.
three_eight.trading_window.name: Trading hours

three_eight.trend_alignment.description: Direction must match the trend state. With no trend, candidates are allowed only in range mode.
three_eight.trend_alignment.name: Trade with the trend

three_eight.trendline_channel.description: A trendline joins swing highs (or lows) with at least min_touches touches within touch_tolerance_pips. Fires when price touches a valid line in the signal direction. A line is invalid after a close beyond it by more than the tolerance. A channel needs a parallel line within parallel_tolerance_pct.
three_eight.trendline_channel.name: Trendlines and channels
three_eight.trendline_channel.source: 3/8 Formula, Trendlines and channels; spec 06 interpretation

three_eight.trigger.description: A candidate exists only when the pivot or Fibonacci indicator fires on the bar. Long when the level is at or below the bar close, short when at or above.
three_eight.trigger.name: Trigger location
three_eight.trigger.source: 3/8 Formula, Trades triggered off pivots; only exception FIBS
